lessons.title: Sevimli Kawaii Tavşanı
lessons.description:
Kolay çizim talimatları ve video eğitimi ile harika görünen bir A Cute Kawaii Bunny çizmeyi öğrenin.
Basit adımları izleyerek siz de kolayca mükemmel một A Cute Kawaii Bunny çizebilirsiniz.

steps.title: Sevimli kawaii tavşan taslağına iki düz tabanlı oval çizerek başlayın.
steps.body: Her gözün içine iki küçük oval çizin ve etraflarını gölgeleyin. Bunlar tavşanın gözleri. Ağzın üst kısmını oluşturmak için aralarına yuvarlak bir "W" çizin.

steps.title: Altta ve üstte açık, tamamlanmamış bir daire çizmek için iki eğri çizgi kullanın.
steps.body: Ağzın üst kısmının altına, dili belirtmek için üzerinde kavisli bir çizgi bulunan "U" şeklinde bir çizgi çizin.

steps.title: Başın üstündeki açık alana tavşanın kulağını kapatın.
steps.body: Uzun bir kavisli çizgiyi uzatın ve kendi üzerine ikiye katlayın. İçine kabaca ana hatta paralel, daha küçük, kavisli bir şekil çizin. Daha küçük şeklin uçlarını bağlayın. Daha sonra diğer kulağı baştan itibaren uzun kavisli bir çizgi uzatıp kendi üzerine katlayarak çizin.

steps.title: İkinci kulağın içine baştan itibaren kavisli bir çizgi uzatın ve onu kendi üzerine katlayın.
steps.body: Başın altındaki açıklıktan gövdeyi oluşturacak şekilde uzun kavisli bir çizgi uzatın. Sonunda, bacağı ve ayağı belirtmek için hafifçe geriye doğru eğin. Tavşanın kolunu oluşturmak için üzerine "U" şeklinde bir çizgi çizin.

steps.title: Diğer ön pençeyi oluşturmak için "C" şeklinde bir çizgi çizin.
steps.body: Pençelerin arasına köşeleri yuvarlatılmış bir üçgen çizin. Bu çıtır bir havuç haline gelecektir.

steps.title: Havucun yapraklı üst kısmını çizmek için bir dizi eğri çizgi kullanın.
steps.body: Daha sonra gövdeyi ve kolun altını çizmek için kısa çizgiler kullanın.

steps.title: Kalan arka bacağı "C" şeklinde bir çizgiyle çizip kısa bir çizgiyle diğer bacağa bağlayın.
steps.body: Kabarık pamuklu kuyruğu kapatmak için başka bir "C" şeklinde çizgi kullanın.

steps.title: Kızarıklığı belirtmek için her gözün altına küçük bir oval çizin.
steps.body: Daha sonra bıyık oluşturmak için yanaktan üç düz çizgi uzatın.

steps.title: Düz bıyıkları karşı yanaktan uzatın.
steps.body: Havucun yüzeyine küçük, düz ovaller çizerek dokulandırın.

steps.title: Sevimli kawaii tavşanınızın taslağı artık tamamlandı.
steps.body: Karakterinizi renklendirin. Kürkünü beyaz bırakabilir veya biraz renk ekleyebilirsiniz. Pembe yanaklar ekleyip havucu renklendirmeyi unutmayın.

lessons.title: Bebek Köpekbalığı
lessons.description:
Kolay çizim talimatları ve video eğitimi ile harika görünen bir A Baby Shark çizmeyi öğrenin.
Basit adımları izleyerek siz de kolayca mükemmel một A Baby Shark çizebilirsiniz.

steps.title: Bebek Köpekbalığı taslağına gözünü çizerek başlayın.
steps.body: Hafifçe kavisli bir çizgi çizin ve üzerine bir daire çizin. Dairenin içindeki ovalin içine bir oval çizin ve aralarını gölgeleyin.

steps.title: Köpekbalığının yüzünün ana hatlarını çizin.
steps.body: Hafifçe sivri burun veya buruna dikkat ederek bir dizi eğri çizgi kullanın.

steps.title: Köpekbalığının göğüs yüzgecini oluşturmak için "V" şeklinde kavisli bir çizgi çizin.
Bu sefer gözün altına “V” şeklinde bir çizgi daha çizin.
steps.body: Köpekbalığının gülümseyen ağzını ve daha hafif olan karnının ana hatlarını çiziyor.

steps.title: Ağzın alt kısmını oluşturmak için ağzın altına kavisli bir çizgi çizin.
steps.body: Daha sonra sivri dişleri çevreleyecek şekilde “V” şeklinde çizgiler çizin.

steps.title: Karşı tarafta göğüs yüzgecini oluşturarak başın altına başka bir üçgen yerleştirin.
steps.body: En yakın yüzgecin üstüne üç paralel eğri çizgi çizin. Bunlar köpekbalığının nefes almak için burun yerine kullandığı solungaçlardır.

steps.title: Köpekbalığının sırt yüzgecini sırtına çizmek için bir noktada buluşan iki eğri çizgiyi kullanın.
Köpekbalığının kuyruğunu çizecek şekilde sırt ve göğüs yüzgeçlerinden uzun kavisli çizgiler uzatın.
Üç eğri çizgiyi kullanarak yarım daire şeklindeki kuyruk yüzgecini çizin.
steps.body: Daha sonra, kuyruktan göğüs yüzgecine kadar, karnın daha hafif olduğunu gösteren uzun, kavisli bir çizgi çizin.

steps.title: Baby Shark taslağınız artık tamamlandı.
steps.body: Karakterinizi renklendirin. Biz kendimizi sarıya boyadık ama bu küçük köpek balıklarının mavi, yeşil, turuncu, pembe ve mor gibi pek çok rengi var.

lessons.title: An Easy Cat Face
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Easy Cat Face with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Easy Cat Face.

steps.title: Begin the cat face outline by drawing the cat’s eyes.
steps.body: Use two curved lines to trace each of the gently pointed shapes.

steps.title: Shade a large, round pupil inside each eye.
steps.body: Then, use a curved line to draw an eyebrow above each eye.

steps.title: Draw a rounded “W” shaped line below and between the eyes.
steps.body: This is the cat’s mouth. Above the central point of the mouth, draw a rounded triangle for the nose.

steps.title: Extend curved lines from the sides of the mouth, forming the cat’s whiskers.
Draw a long curved line around the face.
steps.body: Then, draw a short “U” shaped line below the mouth.

steps.title: Draw the cat’s ears.
steps.body: Use curved lines to enclose the large, partial triangle shapes.

steps.title: Connect the cat’s ears with a curved line, fully enclosing the face.
steps.body: Draw a rounded triangle inside the ear, smaller but parallel to the exterior lines.

steps.title: Draw a rounded triangle in the remaining ear.
steps.body: Then, draw narrow “U” shaped lines along the top of the head, forming stripes.

steps.title: Complete your cat face outline by drawing strips along the cat’s cheeks.
steps.body: Again, use narrow “U” shaped lines of different lengths.

steps.title: Color your cartoon cat face outline.
steps.body: We’ve shaded ours light and dark orange with white markings - a classic marmalade tabby cat like Firestar from Warrior Cats.

lessons.title: An Easy Cartoon Cow
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Easy Cartoon Cow with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Easy Cartoon Cow.

steps.title: Begin the easy cartoon cow outline by drawing the animal's cute face.
steps.body: Draw a large curved shape for the snout. Inside it, draw a wide "U" shaped line for the mouth and shade two small ovals for the nostrils. Above it, enclose two partial ovals for the eyes. Inside each eye, draw a smaller oval and shade around it.

steps.title: Above the eyes, use connected, curved lines to enclose a cloudlike shape.
steps.body: This is a tuft of fur on top of the cow's head. Connect the fur to the snout with curved lines. From the sides of the cow's head, extend curved lines and double them back on themselves to form the horns.

steps.title: Below the horns, extend another set of curved lines and double them back on themselves to form the cow's ears.
steps.body: Draw a curved line to contour each ear. Draw a partial circle beneath the head and draw two pairs of lines from it to the snout. This will become a collar with a bell.

steps.title: Use a curved line to enclose the irregular shape of the cowbell.
steps.body: Draw a curved line across the bottom of the bell, and enclose a half-circle underneath it. Then draw a curved line from the side of the collar to the bell.

steps.title: For each leg, draw a long curved line and double it back on itself.
steps.body: Notice how the legs get smaller just above the hooves, and they are flattened on the bottom. Band each leg with a curved line, then use another curved line for the belly.

steps.title: Use a long curved line to draw the cow's back and rear leg.
steps.body: Band the leg with a curved line in the narrow spot just above the hoof.

steps.title: Use a series of curved lines to enclose the udder and the remaining rear foot.
steps.body: Band the narrow part of the leg with a curved line.

steps.title: Extend two curved lines from the cow's rump, allowing them to meet.
steps.body: This is the cow's tail. Draw a teardrop-shaped tuft of fur at the tip of the tail. Texture the hairs with curved lines.

steps.title: Use curved lines to enclose spots all over the cow's body.
Your easy cartoon cow outline is now complete.
steps.body: Color your cute character. Many spotted cows are white with black spots. Others are brown with white spots.

lessons.title: An Easy Unicorn Face
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Easy Unicorn Face with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Easy Unicorn Face.

steps.title: Begin the easy unicorn face outline by drawing its eye.
steps.body: Use two curved lines for the top and bottom of the eye, and two for the sides. Notice how the eyelids overlap the eye. Within the eye, draw an oval inside an oval, and shade between them. This indicates the pupil.

steps.title: Draw the remaining eye.
steps.body: Again, use two curved lines for the top and bottom of the eye, and two for the sides. Within the eye, draw an oval inside an oval, and shade between them.

steps.title: Enclose a teardrop shape above each eye to indicate the eyebrows.
steps.body: Draw a curved line between the eyes to contour the face.

steps.title: Draw a large “U” shaped line below the eyes, with short lines adorning each end.
steps.body: This isn’t your typical smiling mouth - it is actually the bottom of the unicorn head, the horse’s nose.

steps.title: Use long curved lines to sketch the sides of the unicorn head.
steps.body: Draw two small circles on the snout to indicate the nostrils.

steps.title: Draw the ears at the top of the unicorn head.
steps.body: Use a long curved line to sketch each ear overlapping the side of the head, and another line to detail inside the ear.

steps.title: Begin drawing the unicorn’s namesake spiral horn.
steps.body: Use a series of overlapping curved lines to create the spiral design.

steps.title: Draw the final layers of the horn as well as its pointed tip.
Complete your easy unicorn face outline by drawing the mane on top of the head.
steps.body: Use curved lines of various lengths that meet at jagged points.

steps.title: Color your cartoon of an easy unicorn face.
steps.body: We’ve given ours a classic white coat of fur, with a candy-colored mane and horn.

lessons.title: A Cute Unicorn Cat
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Cute Unicorn Cat with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Cute Unicorn Cat.

steps.title: Draw two ovals with the right oval at a slight angle.
steps.body: Sketch smaller ovals inside these shapes, then draw two more ovals inside. Keep these ovals white, and fill in the rest of the shapes.

steps.title: In the center, draw a round triangle with a loose W shape underneath.
steps.body: Sketch curvy triangles like wings on one side of each eye, and fill them in. Add two dashes above the eyes like you're drawing a chibi cat.

steps.title: Draw a loop underneath the mouth with two hills inside for the tongue.
steps.body: Sketch a curve on either side of the face, then sketch triangles for the fur and bring the left curve upward.

steps.title: Complete the head with a curve like a dome.
steps.body: Draw two rounded triangles for the ears with matching triangles inside these shapes.

steps.title: Sketch a triangle with a round bottom like a cone, then draw lines inside the triangle.
steps.body: Use sketchy lines to create a tuft of fur underneath the chin.

steps.title: Add more sketchy lines underneath the head.
steps.body: Draw one curve for the chest, then two curves pointing in the opposite direction for the leg. Sketch tufts of fur on the left curve.

steps.title: Draw a curve to the left, make a loop for the foot, then sketch a smaller curve.
steps.body: Add a loop on the other leg and outline the toes with dashes.

steps.title: Complete the underside of the body with a curve, then use loops for the other two feet and outline the toes.
Use curves and squiggly lines to outline the tail.
steps.body: Don't worry about making it look perfect.

steps.title: Finally, outline your cartoon cute unicorn cat in black, then grab your favorite coloring tools.
steps.body: Make sure you erase the stray pencil lines.

lessons.title: The Yellow Angry Bird
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Yellow Angry Bird with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Yellow Angry Bird.

steps.title: Begin by drawing a rounded triangle.
steps.body: Notice that the sides are slightly curved and the corners are gently pointed. This forms both the head and body.

steps.title: Draw the tuft of feathers at the top of Chuck's head.
steps.body: Extend curved lines from the head, then connect them using a series of curved, "V" shaped lines that meet at sharp points.

steps.title: Draw Chuck's tail.
steps.body: Extend curved lines from the side of the triangle, then connect them using a series of curved, "V" shaped lines that meet at sharp points.

steps.title: Draw Chuck's angry eyebrow.
steps.body: Draw a narrow rectangle positioned at a diagonal slant near the top of the triangle.

steps.title: Draw Chuck's remaining eyebrow.
steps.body: Sketch a narrow rectangle that crosses outside the triangle. Erase guide lines as necessary.

steps.title: Draw Chuck's beak.
steps.body: Extend two curved lines from a point near the center of the triangle. This forms the outside of the beak. Then, connect the lines using a crooked "V" shaped line. This forms the inside of the open mouth.

steps.title: Detail the beak.
steps.body: Extend a straight line from the tip of the inner "V," extending the bottom of the top portion of the beak. Then, enclose the open mouth or tongue using a curved, "V" shaped line.

steps.title: Draw Chuck's eye.
steps.body: Enclose a partial circle beneath one eyebrow. Indicate the pupil by shading a small circle in the center of the eye.

steps.title: Use curved lines to enclose a partial circle between the remaining brow and the beak, forming the eye.
steps.body: Shade a small circle at its center to indicate the pupil.

steps.title: Color Chuck.
steps.body: He is typically bright yellow in color, with an orange beak, red eyebrows, and black tuft and tail.

lessons.title: A Cartoon Seahorse
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Cartoon Seahorse with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Cartoon Seahorse.

steps.title: Begin the cartoon seahorse outline by drawing its eye.
steps.body: Draw short curved lines for the upper and lower lids, then enclose a partial oval between them.

steps.title: Draw an oval within an oval inside the eye, and shade between them to indicate the pupil.
steps.body: Draw two curved lines above the eye to detail the upper eyelid and eyebrow.

steps.title: Draw a long curved line around the eye to sketch the seahorse's head.
steps.body: Double it back upon itself at the front to form the snout and smiling mouth. Draw a short curved line at the corner of the mouth.

steps.title: Draw a curved line overlapping the mouth to form the lower jaw.
steps.body: From the bottom of the jaw, extend a long spiral line. This forms the seahorse's belly and its spiral-shaped tail.

steps.title: Draw a line from the back of the head to the tip of the tail, completely enclosing the animal's body.
steps.body: Then, extend a short curved line from the head. Draw another line meeting it at a point. This begins the fish's dorsal fin.

steps.title: Continue drawing the dorsal fin along the head, neck, and back.
steps.body: Use short curved lines that meet at points. Notice how the lines get shorter near the bottom of the fin.

steps.title: Draw another fin in the middle of the back.
steps.body: Use connected "U" shaped lines to form a scalloped pattern.

steps.title: Texture the fins with curved lines.
Draw a long curved line from the head to the tail, loosely parallel to the outline of the belly.
steps.body: Then, texture the belly with horizontal curved lines.

steps.title: Your cartoon seahorse outline is now complete.
steps.body: Color your drawing. Seahorses come in many bright colors, including red, yellow, orange, and green, while others are dull and brown.

lessons.title: An Easy Cartoon Sheep
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Easy Cartoon Sheep with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Easy Cartoon Sheep.

steps.title: Begin the easy cartoon sheep outline by drawing the animal’s face.
steps.body: Use a curved triangle for the nose and ovals that are flat on the bottom for the eyes. Draw a smaller oval inside each eye and shade between them.

steps.title: Draw a rounded “W” shaped line below the nose to indicate the mouth.
steps.body: Use a “U” shaped line to indicate the open mouth below it. Add the detail of the tongue using a curved line.

steps.title: Outline the sheep’s face with a long curved line.
steps.body: At the top of the line - the lamb’s forehead - draw a puffy tuft of woolen fur. Use a series of connected “U” shaped lines.

steps.title: Complete the round, fluffy shape using connected “U” shaped lines.
steps.body: Then, draw the sheep’s ears by extending long curved lines and doubling them back upon themselves. This fully encloses the sheep’s face.

steps.title: Begin drawing the sheep’s fluffy, wooly body.
steps.body: Use a series of connected “U” shaped lines. Notice that all the lines are not the same size.

steps.title: Complete the rounded body of the sheep using connected “U” shaped lines.
steps.body: Then, extend a pair of curved lines below the body to form the leg.

steps.title: Draw another leg, again extending a pair of lines from the body.
steps.body: Then, use two curved lines to enclose a half-circle shape at the bottom of each leg. These are the sheep’s feet or hooves.

steps.title: Draw two more legs, again extending pairs of curved lines from the body.
steps.body: Conclude each leg with a rounded half-circle-shaped hoof.

steps.title: Use a series of connected “U” shaped lines to enclose the sheep’s round tail against its body.
steps.body: Detail each hoof by drawing a short line on the front of it.

steps.title: Your cartoon sheep outline is now complete.
steps.body: Often, sheep are depicted as having white wool, but not all sheep do. Some are solid black, or white and tan with brown faces. Others are speckled and spotted with white, black, brown, gray, and tan.

lessons.title: A Cute Fox
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Cute Fox with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Cute Fox.

steps.title: Begin the cute fox outline by drawing its eye and nose.
steps.body: For the eye, use four curved lines to enclose a partial oval shape. Shade a large oval-shaped pupil inside it. Then, draw a circle for the tip of the nose. Extend a curved line for the top of the snout.

steps.title: Draw the remaining eye on the opposite side of the nose.
steps.body: Again, use four curved lines. Then, draw a "W" shaped line under the nose. Beneath it, use curved lines to enclose the open mouth and tongue.

steps.title: Shade a large oval-shaped pupil inside the remaining eye.
steps.body: Contour above the eyes with curved lines. Use a long curved line for the bottom of the face and a series of connected curved lines for tufts of fur on each cheek.

steps.title: Enclose the triangular eye using long curved lines, then draw another incomplete triangle inside it.
steps.body: Then, use curved lines to draw the top of the head and its tuft of fur.

steps.title: Draw the remaining triangle-shaped ear using long curved lines.
steps.body: Contour inside it with long lines and jagged lines that indicate tufts of fur.

steps.title: Use a series of connected curved lines to draw the fox's furry chest and front leg.
Draw the remaining foreleg, doubling a line back on itself.
steps.body: Detail the paws with short lines. Then use a long curved line for the fox's back. Indicate the front of the rear leg with a curved line.

steps.title: Use long curved lines to sketch the fox's long, fluffy tail.
steps.body: Notice how the lines meet in jagged tufts at the tip.

steps.title: Use curved lines to create the markings on the fox's face, front paws, and the tip of its tail.
Your cute fox outline is now complete.
steps.body: Color your cartoon fox.

lessons.title: A Baby Husky
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Baby Husky with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Baby Husky.

steps.title: Begin the baby husky outline by drawing its face.
steps.body: Enclose a rounded, upside-down triangle for the pad of the nose.

steps.title: Draw a rounded “W” shaped line under the nose to form the tip of the snout.
steps.body: Draw the remaining eye, again using two curved lines and two partial oval shapes. Shade the smaller oval and contour the upper eyelids with short lines.

steps.title: Use a long, curved line to draw the puppy’s head.
steps.body: At the side of the face, use pairs of curved lines that meet at jagged points to offer a furry texture. Shade curved eyebrows above each eye. Enclose the open mouth using a curved line, and the tongue inside it with a rounded “M” shaped line.

steps.title: Extend two curved lines from the top of the head and double them back on themselves to enclose the triangular ears.
steps.body: Contour each ear with a curved line. Texture the fur at the base of the nearest ear. Use pairs of curved lines that meet at points.

steps.title: Texture inside the remaining ear with short lines.
steps.body: Then, draw the dog’s body. Use curved lines for the back and belly. Outline the thick fur on the chest using several sets of connected, curved lines.

steps.title: Use long curved lines to sketch the front legs.
steps.body: Notice the jagged fur at one knee. Then, enclose the paw. Use a “C” shaped line for the top of the paw. Allow it to overlap with a “U” shaped line, defining the toes.

steps.title: Use overlapping curved lines to sketch the remaining forepaw and the rear leg.
Draw a short curved line between the front paws to indicate the remaining rear paw between them.
steps.body: Then, use long and short curved lines to enclose the jagged fur of the fluffy tail.

steps.title: Use long curved lines to add markings to the puppy’s face.
steps.body: Then, texture the tail with a series of short lines.

steps.title: Your baby husky outline is now complete.
steps.body: Color your drawing. Huskies are usually black, gray, brown, or blonde with white markings.

lessons.title: A Dolphin Heart
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Dolphin Heart with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Dolphin Heart.

steps.title: Begin the dolphin heart outline by drawing the beak of the first dolphin.
steps.body: Use a curved, "U" shaped line for the beak. Then draw the eye. Use a curved line for the cheek, and enclose a partial oval above it. Draw a smaller oval inside the eye and shade between them. Then, use a short curved line for the eyebrow.

steps.title: Use curved lines to trace the dolphin's sleek body.
steps.body: Extend a long curved line from the top of the beak to form the animal's head, back, and tail. Extend a line below the beak to begin tracing the dolphin's chest. Draw a curved line across the beak to indicate the mouth.

steps.title: Extend a curved line from the dolphin's body and double it back upon itself to form the flipper.
steps.body: Continue the line of the belly below the flipper to the base of the tail. Then, use another curved line to trace one of the dolphin's tail fins.

steps.title: Use curved lines to enclose the dorsal fin on the dolphin's back, the remaining pectoral fin, and the opposite side of the tail fin.
Now, you will draw another dolphin, a mirror image of the first.
steps.body: Use a curved line for the beak, touching the beak of the original dolphin. Then draw the eye, using curved lines for the brow and cheek, and ovals for the eye itself.

steps.title: Use a long curved line to trace the dolphin's head and back, and a shorter line for the smiling mouth.
Draw the pectoral fin using a curved line that doubles back upon itself.
steps.body: Extend a long curved line from the bottom of the beak, behind the fin, to the base of the dolphin's tail.

steps.title: Use curved lines to enclose the tail fin.
Complete the dolphin heart outline by drawing the pectoral fin and the dorsal fin.
steps.body: Use curved lines for each.

steps.title: Color your heart-shaped dolphin cartoon.

lessons.title: An Easy Cartoon Dragon
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Easy Cartoon Dragon with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Easy Cartoon Dragon.

steps.title: On the right side of the page, draw a hook shape with the occasional loops that break up the line.
Starting from the bottom of this shape, sketch a curved line that trails downward, then curve the line upward into a hook.
steps.body: Draw another line parallel to the hook to create the tail. On the right, draw a straight diagonal line with a dash at the top. Draw another hook, then sketch a crooked, oblong horizontal line underneath.

steps.title: Use an L-shape for the elbow.
steps.body: Follow this with a curve, then sketch loose, curvy triangles for the claws. For the right hand, start with two straight lines, and repeat the earlier for the other set of claws.

steps.title: Draw the stomach with two curves.
steps.body: Add another curve to start the leg, then draw a straight line that curves downward.

steps.title: Complete the left leg with another L-shape.
steps.body: Use chunky triangles for the toes. On the right, add a rectangle that ends in a downward curve.

steps.title: Draw a curve to start the right side of the face.
steps.body: Make a loop, then draw a horizontal straight line that curves upward to form the mouth. On the left, draw a wavy S-shape and sketch two curves underneath the mouth. For the eyes, draw egg shapes with curved lines at the bottom. Use circles for the pupils, then add smaller circles and erase them. Add dashes for the eyelids and eyebrows. Finally, use another loop and two ovals for the nostrils.

steps.title: Draw two curvy elongated triangles for the horns.
Sketch several loops like small hills for the scales on the back.
To draw the left wing, make a vertical curved line, then swoop it over in a horizontal curved line like the top of an umbrella.
steps.body: Repeat this process for the right wing. Underneath the left wing, draw three loops like the curved edges of a shell. Add lines to give the wings more depth. To complete your easy cartoon dragon, outline the entire drawing with a black pen.

steps.title: Color your easy cartoon dragon with light green for the body and dark green for the shadows.
steps.body: Use pale yellow for the horns, scales and claws.

lessons.title: Nemo
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Nemo with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Nemo.

steps.title: Begin by drawing an egg shape to outline Nemo's head.
Extend long, curved lines from the shape, outlining the body.
Continue these lines, flaring them outward to form the tail.
Erase the guide lines from Nemo's head.
Enclose the tail using a scalloped, wavy line.
steps.body: Draw a set of long, curved lines around the head, forming Nemo's first stripe.

steps.title: Draw a small oval near the bottom of the head using a dotted line.
steps.body: From the oval, extend two slightly curved lines, one longer than the other. Connect the lines using a scalloped, wavy line to form the pectoral fin.

steps.title: Erase the guide lines from the fin.
Detail the fin with another scalloped line parallel to the first.
steps.body: Draw several curved and "U" shaped lines within the fin.

steps.title: Draw curved lines across Nemo's body to form two more sets of stripes.
Draw a scalloped line parallel to each of the lines of the last stripe.
steps.body: Draw two scalloped lines along the tip of the tail, and another near the line where the tail meets the body. Draw curved lines of various sizes down the length of the tail to add detail.

steps.title: Draw a wavy line from the top of Nemo's head to the base of his tail, forming his dorsal fin.
Detail the fin by drawing two sets of scalloped lines within each portion of the dorsal fin.
steps.body: Then, draw curved lines across the fin.

steps.title: Extend a curved, scalloped line from the side of Nemo's face, forming the other dorsal fin.
steps.body: Since this is Nemo's "lucky fin" - the one that was damaged when he was still in the egg - let the line dip inward to indicate the irregularity of shape.

steps.title: Draw a scalloped line across the lucky fin, and detail it with several slightly curved lines.
Draw two ovals to form Nemo's eyes.
Within the eye, draw a circle within a circle.
steps.body: Draw a tiny circle between the two circles, and shade the innermost circle.

steps.title: Repeat this process in the other eye.
Draw a wide "U" shaped line to form Nemo's smiling mouth.
steps.body: Connect it at the top with a slightly curved line, and adorn each corner with a short, curved line.

steps.title: Draw two curved lines within the mouth, outlining the teeth.
steps.body: Shade between the lines.

steps.title: Color Nemo.
steps.body: As a tropical clownfish, he is bright orange in color with white and black stripes.

lessons.title: A Cute Lion For Kids
lessons.description:
Learn how to draw a great looking Cute Lion for Kids with easy drawing instructions and video tutorial.
By following the simple steps, you too can easily draw a perfect Cute Lion for Kids.

steps.title: Begin the cute lion for kids outline by drawing its large eyes.
steps.body: For each eye, draw a curved line, then enclose an oval shape on top of it. Shade a smaller oval inside each eye. Draw a small inverted triangle between the eyes - this is the lion's nose.

steps.title: Draw a curved "W" below the nose and a "U" shaped line below that.
steps.body: This outlines the lion's mouth. Inside the mouth, use short lines to sketch the two fangs, the teeth between them, and the tongue.

steps.title: Use a long curved line to outline the lion's face.
steps.body: Use short lines for the whiskers on each side of the nose and the dimple below the chin.

steps.title: Use a curved line and a "C" shaped line to draw each ear.
steps.body: Then, at the top of the face, begin drawing the mane. Use pairs of curved lines that meet at points.

steps.title: Use a series of connected, curved lines to begin drawing the cloudlike mane around the lion's head.
steps.body: Use short lines to contour inside the ears and to form the eyebrows.

steps.title: Use a series of curved lines to complete the mane, and another to draw the leg and paw.
Draw the remaining foreleg, then draw a "C" shaped line on each side.
steps.body: Connect these to the mane with short lines, forming the lion's sides and rear legs.

steps.title: Use a series of curved lines to enclose each of the lion's rear feet.
steps.body: Then extend a pair of curved lines from one of the back legs. This will become the lion's tail.

steps.title: Enclose a partial circle on the bottom of each foot.
steps.body: Then, use a series of curved lines to enclose a fluffy tuft of fur at the tip of the tail.

steps.title: Your cute lion outline is now complete.
steps.body: Color your character. Most lions are tan with darker manes.

steps.title: Gözleri çizerek başlayın.
steps.body: İki spiral kavisli çizgi çizin. Üstlerinde, kaşların ana hatlarını çizmek için bir noktada buluşan iki kalın kavisli çizgi kullanın.

steps.title: Kırışık kaşları belirtmek için gözlerin üzerine kavisli çizgiler çizin.
steps.body: Burun için kısa bir çizgi kullanın. Aşağı dönük ağzı kavisli çizgilerle ana hatlarıyla belirtin ve dişleri ve dili belirtmek için ek kavisli çizgiler kullanın.

steps.title: Yüzünüze düşen saç buklelerini çizin.
steps.body: Her biri için iki eğri çizgi kullanın. Ayrıca nazik bir noktada buluşan kavisli çizgiler kullanarak çeneyi ve yanakları çizin.

steps.title: Gerektiğinde silerek, alnına düşen daha fazla saç çizin.
steps.body: Her kilit için iki eğri çizgi kullanın ve çizgilerin keskin noktalarda buluşmasına izin verin.

steps.title: Daha fazla saç tutamı çizin.
steps.body: Yüzün yanındaki kilitlerden birinin önceki kilidin arkasından nasıl geçtiğine dikkat edin. Saçları başın üstünden çizmeye başlayın ve çizgilerin her iki uçta bir noktada buluşmasını sağlayın.

steps.title: Saçı başın bir tarafında çizmeye devam etmek için keskin noktalarda buluşan üst üste binen kavisli çizgiler çizin.
Saçı başın karşı tarafındaki tamamlayın.
steps.body: Keskin noktalarda buluşan çizgi çiftlerini kullanın. Saçı ek kavisli çizgilerle dokulandırın.

steps.title: Eğri çizgiler kullanarak boynun ana hatlarını çizin.
steps.body: "U" şeklinde bir çizgi kullanarak giysinin yakasını çizin. Daha sonra ensedeki saçları tamamlayın. Yine pürüzlü noktalarda buluşan çizgi çiftlerini kullanın.

steps.title: Yakanın kalan tarafını "U" şeklinde bir çizgi kullanarak tamamlayın.
steps.body: Daha sonra bluzun omuzlarını ve kolunu belirlemek için kavisli çizgiler kullanın. Bir düğmeyi belirtmek için yakanın altına bir daire çizin.

lessons.title: Anime ve Manga Gözler
lessons.description: A beginner-friendly guide to learning how to draw a great-looking Anime and Manga Eyes with easy, step by step drawing instructions and video tutorial. Great for beginner artists!

steps.title: İki oval çizin.
steps.body: Dikey konumlarına ve geniş aralıklı olduklarına dikkat edin.

steps.title: Her gözün üst kısmına kavisli bir çizgi çizin.
steps.body: Çizginin gözlerin dış taraflarında daha uzun olduğuna ve yanlara doğru kıvrıldığına dikkat edin. İç köşede çizgi daha kısadır ve ovalin yaklaşık yarısında durur.

steps.title: Gözlere kalın bir çerçeve çizin.
steps.body: Önceki adımda çizgilerin noktalarını karşılayan eğri çizgiler çizin. Dış köşelerde, kirpikleri belirtmek için pürüzlü noktalarda buluşan bir dizi eğri çizgi kullanın. Göz kapağının çevresini oluşturmak için gözün üst kısmından uzanan kısa kavisli çizgiye de dikkat edin.

steps.title: Göz çevresindeki kenarları kalın, koyu çizgiler haline getirerek gölgeleyin.
steps.body: Gözbebeğini belirtmek için her gözün içine küçük bir oval gölgelendirin. Her gözün alt kısmına kirpikleri belirtmek için kavisli bir çizgi ve birkaç küçük üçgen çizin. Kirpikleri gölgeleyin.

steps.title: Sivri kaşları gözlerin üzerine çizmek için kavisli çizgiler kullanın.
Her gözün irisinin içine bir oval ve bir daire yerleştirin.
steps.body: Bu ona karakteristik ışıltılı bir görünüm kazandırır.

lessons.title: Anime Erkek Saçı
lessons.description: Adım adım anime erkak saçı çizmeyi öğrenin.

steps.title: Use a long curved line to outline the head and facial features.
steps.body: Use another curved line to draw the ear.

steps.title: Detail the face, using the contours of the outline as a guide.
steps.body: Align the eye with the indentation below the brow bone. Center the eyebrow in the brow bone directly above the eye.

steps.title: Sketch the hairline beside the contour line on the side of the face, like in the buzzed hairstyle above.
steps.body: Then, use a series of overlapping curved lines to draw the flattened oval shape of the hair on top of the head. From the point where the hair meets the forehead, extend two long curved lines and allow them to meet at a point, forming a long lock or bang.

steps.title: Draw the bun at the back of the head; it is more readily visible from this angle.
steps.body: Start with an irregular round shape. Then, use curved lines that meet at points to enclose the hair tie and tufts of hair. Texture the bun with curved lines of different lengths.

steps.title: Texture the hair on top of the head with curved lines.
Color your drawing.

lessons.title: Anime Erkek Çocuk Yüzü
lessons.description: Anime erkek çocuk yüzü çizme rehberi.

steps.title: Begin by drawing a circle.
steps.body: This will serve as a guide line for crafting the shape of the head.

steps.title: Draw a straight vertical line and a straight horizontal line through the center of the circle.
steps.body: The lines should cross at a perpendicular angle exactly at the circle's middle. The horizontal line should extend some distance beneath the circle, forming a "t" shape.

steps.title: Begin sketching the lower face.
steps.body: The face should be located in the lower-left quadrant formed by the perpendicular lines. Use short, curved lines to sketch the nose, lips, chin, and neck of the anime side view.

steps.title: Use a short straight line and a short curved line to enclose the mouth.
Use a "C" shaped line to outline the ear.
steps.body: The ear should cross the vertical guide line, appearing in both lower quadrants of the head. Then, use a series of short curved lines to detail the inner ear.

steps.title: Erase the circle from the lower left quadrant of the head.
steps.body: Then, erase the perpendicular lines. You now have a clean outline of the anime side profile head. He's bald, a state which the next will rectify.

steps.title: Use a series of curved lines of various lengths to sketch the hair.
steps.body: Notice how the lines meet in gentle to sharp points, forming locks of hair. These locks are especially prevalent around the face and at the back of the head. Use another curved line to draw the back of the neck.

steps.title: Erase the guide line left by the original circle that appears within the outline of the hair.
steps.body: Now, you again have a clean outline.

steps.title: Detail the hair with a series of short, curved lines that meet at jagged points.
steps.body: Detail the face by drawing the eye. Use three curved lines to sketch the triangular shape of the eye, allowing the lines to extend past the forward-facing short side of the triangle.

steps.title: Color your picture

steps.title: Start with a circle to the left, then draw two circles inside the shape and fill them in.
steps.body: Draw a dash to the right, and sketch a wavy W shape underneath.

steps.title: Sketch two lines on either side of the face to start the kawaii cat head.
steps.body: Add two ovals underneath the eyes, then draw a loop underneath the W shape for the mouth.

steps.title: Draw another curve for the top of the head.
steps.body: Add two triangles for the ears.

steps.title: Outline a triangle inside each ear to give them more depth.
Sketch whiskers on either side of the face, then draw a loop with two lines for the left paw.
To the right, make another loop with a wavy W shape underneath.
On the left, draw a wavy vertical line, then sketch a loop for the left foot.
Draw a curved line on the right that ends in a hook.
steps.body: Sketch another curved line on top to complete the right foot.

steps.title: Use a long oval for the tail, then draw a curve to complete the cat's body and add dashes for the toes.
Color your picture

lessons.title: Anime Chibi Kız
lessons.description: Anime tarzı bir chibi kız çizmeyi öğrenin.

steps.title: Begin by using a large, curved line to draw the shape of the head.
steps.body: This irregular rounded shape should have two parts - the bulge of the forehead and the bulge of the cheeks.

steps.title: Draw the girl's hair.
steps.body: First, draw a long curved line parallel to the top of the head. Then, use curved lines of various lengths to draw locks of hair within the shape of the head, covering the face. The lines should meet at jagged points. Then, connect the exterior curved line to the hair covering the face using short lines that meet at jagged points.

steps.title: Erase the original lines from within the hair.
Draw a headband holding back the hair.
steps.body: Use two curved lines to enclose a curved shape, pointed on both ends.

steps.title: Extend two short curved lines beneath the head to form the neck.
steps.body: Then, draw the collar of the garment. Extend a short straight line from each side of the neck. Then, draw curved lines to form two curved triangle shapes. The triangles should meet at the base of the neck. Beneath their tips, draw a small circle to form the knot in a scarf. Below this, enclose two pointed shapes using curved lines.

steps.title: Draw the girl's shirt.
steps.body: Extend pairs of long curved lines to form the arms, and connect them at the bottom with a curved line. Draw a long curved line between the sleeves, enclosing the bottom of the shirt. Band each sleeve with a pair of curved lines. Then, use curved and "U" shaped lines to draw the hands.

steps.title: Draw the skirt.
steps.body: Enclose a curved rectangle below the shirt. Band it with pairs of vertical lines.

steps.title: Draw each leg using a long, curved line.
steps.body: Allow the line to double back upon itself. Band each leg with curved lines to indicate the top and cuff of the sock, the top of the shoe, and the toe of the shoe.

steps.title: Draw the chibi girl's face.
steps.body: Enclose several ovals within one another to form the eyes. Shade one in each to indicate the pupils. Use curved lines to draw the eyebrows, eyelids, and smiling mouth.

steps.title: Color your picture

lessons.title: Shin-chan
lessons.description: Crayon Shin-chan'dan Shinnosuke Nohara'yı çizin.

steps.title: Begin the Shinnosuke Nohara from Crayon Shin-Chan outline by drawing Shin-Chan's eyes.
steps.body: For each eye, draw a large oval. Shade the lines of the ovals heavily. Then, draw a curved line above each oval to form the eyelids.

steps.title: Use a long curved line to draw the top of the cartoon character's head.
steps.body: Then, draw an inverted "V" shape above each eye to form the eyelids. Shade the "V" shaped line heavily.

steps.title: Use a small "C" shaped line for the ear and a larger "C" shaped line for the jaw, enclosing the entire shape of the face.
Draw Shin-Chan's mouth using an irregular circle to overlap the bottom of the face.
steps.body: Erase the line within the mouth. Then, use two curved lines that meet in an "L" shape to outline his hair.

steps.title: Draw Shin-Chan's shirt.
steps.body: Use straight lines to trace the rectangular sleeves, and slightly curved lines to outline the torso of the t-shirt.

steps.title: Draw Shin-Chan's arms.
steps.body: One arm is behind his back; draw the elbow using a short curved line. For the other arm, extend two straight lines from the sleeve. Then, draw several overlapping curved lines to sketch his fingers and hand making a peace sign.

steps.title: Draw Shin-Chan's shorts.
steps.body: Use straight lines for the sides of the garment, and curved lines for the legs and inseam.

steps.title: Draw the first of Shin-Chan's legs.
steps.body: Extend a pair of straight lines from the leg of the shorts. At the bottom, use curved lines to enclose the sharply pointed shape of the shoe. Band the bottom of the leg with a straight line to indicate the top of the sock.

steps.title: Complete your Shinnosuke Nohara from Crayon Shin-Chan outline by drawing the remaining leg.
steps.body: Again, extend a pair of straight lines from the leg of the shorts.

steps.title: Color your picture

steps.title: Sayfanın ortasına yakın iki yumurta şeklinde oval çizin.
steps.body: Bu şekillerin içine iki küçük halka çizin ve süsenleri oluşturmak için içlerini doldurun.

steps.title: İki göz arasına, sol gözün üzerine gelecek şekilde bir daire çizin.
steps.body: Dairenin altına kavisli bir dikey çizgi çizin, ardından her iki ucundan yukarı doğru kıvrılan yatay bir çizgi çizin.

steps.title: Kafayı oluşturmak için yüzün çevresine gevşek bir daire şekli çizin.
steps.body: Çemberin %100 eşit olması gerekmez.

Yakayı oluşturmak için kafanın altına uzun bir erişte şekli çizin.
steps.body: Yakanın ortasına yakın bir daire çizin, ardından zili yapmak için dairenin üzerine başka bir erişte şekli çizin.

steps.title: Solda hafif kavisli çizgiler çizin ve bunları büyük bir daireyle birleştirin.
steps.body: Dairenin tabanının biraz düz olduğundan emin olun. Sağda, altında başka bir daire bulunan dikdörtgen bir şekil çizin.

steps.title: Sağ ayağı oluşturmak için vücudun sağ tarafına yakın bir yere büyük bir daire çizin.
steps.body: Üst tarafa doğru kısa, kavisli bir çizgi çizin, ardından gövdeye doğru yukarı doğru kıvrılan başka bir çizgi çizin.

steps.title: Diğer ayağı yapmak için vücudun soluna başka bir büyük oval çizin.

steps.title: Vücudun içinde, mide üzerinde bir daire oluşturmak için iki eğri çizgi kullanın.
steps.body: Bu şeklin içine gülümseyen bir ağza benzeyen yarım daire çizin.

lessons.title: Goku Black
lessons.description: Dragon Ball Super'in güçlü düşmanı.

steps.title: Start with a small dash near the top-third of the page.
steps.body: Add two diagonal lines pointing upward, then sketch two straight lines to form the jawline. Inside the face, draw two triangles pointing toward each other. Draw two thinner triangles on top of these and fill them in to make the eyebrows. For the anime eyes, draw two circles inside the triangles and fill them in. Draw short dashes between the eyes, then sketch an L-shape underneath. Lightly sketch a triangle on the other side of the nose, then use three curved lines underneath to form the mouth.

steps.title: To the right of the face, draw a large zigzag with two triangles.
steps.body: Sketch another zigzag on the top of the head. Use oblong ovals to make the ears, then use curved lines to create more detail.

steps.title: Draw two short lines to make the neck.
steps.body: Add a circle underneath the right ear, then use large, sweeping zigzag lines to make the pointy hair. Make sure you vary the sizes of the triangles and use a combination of straight and curved lines. Add two diagonal lines above the eyebrows.

steps.title: Start at the right side of the neck and draw a sweeping line pointing downward.
steps.body: Draw a shorter line near the top of this line to make a Y-shape. Sketch lightly curved lines inside this space to make the neck muscles. To the left, draw two small hill shapes and connect them with a straight line. Draw two diagonal lines pointing downward. On the right, draw three straight lines that make a vaguely looped shape, then connect them to the body with another straight line. Use curved lines to complete the sleeve.

steps.title: Draw a straight diagonal line pointing downward from the sleeve, then sweep it upwards in a curved line.
steps.body: Use thick noodle shapes to make the fingers. Add a semi-circle for the palm, then draw a gentle curve to complete the arm. Add another semi-circle and accentuate it with two curved lines.

steps.title: For the left arm, draw a short line pointing downward, then sweep it upward in a curved line.
steps.body: Use narrow noodle shapes for the fingers, making sure that they overlap. Draw a semi-circle for the palm. Sketch another curved line and a semi-circle for the arm, then use dashes for the knuckles. Draw a short curved line near the wrist.

steps.title: Underneath the body, draw a slightly curved line.
steps.body: Draw an identical line a half-inch below it, then use hill shapes to connect the lines. Connect this shape to the body with two curved lines above. Use sweeping lines to make the bottom of the robe, then sketch a loose M-shape underneath like a bird flying in the distance.

steps.title: To the left, make three looped shapes that gradually get smaller.
steps.body: Draw another loop underneath, then make two more loops to form the left leg. Repeat this process with the right leg. Underneath each leg, draw two lines pointing downward. For the right foot, sketch an oblong circle. For the left foot, draw one diagonal line, lightly curve it underneath and make a small hill shape near the ankle.

steps.title: Sketch a variety of straight and curved lines to make the folds of the clothes.
steps.body: Add a few lines to the ankles of the boots to give them more depth. Outline your entire drawing with a black pen or marker, then erase the extra lines.

steps.title: Color your picture

lessons.title: Luffy
lessons.description: One Piece'in gelecekteki korsanlar kralı.

steps.title: Begin by drawing Luffy's eyes and nose.
steps.body: For the eyes, shade two small circles for the pupils, then use curved lines to draw incomplete circles around them. Unlike most anime eyes, Luffy's are circular instead of rectangular. Draw a thick straight line above each eye to form the eyebrows. Between the brows, draw two short lines to indicate the furrowed expression. Use curved lines to enclose the triangular nose. Finally, draw a curved line below one eye and cross it with two short lines to indicate the scar.

steps.title: Draw a long curved line to form the chin and cheeks.
steps.body: Draw another curved line around each end of the first line to enclose the ears. Detail the insides of the ears with short curved lines. Then, draw the mouth using a curved trapezoid. Draw a curved horizontal line across the mouth to separate the top and bottom teeth.

steps.title: Draw Luffy's spiky manga hair.
steps.body: Use curved lines that meet at jagged points.

steps.title: Extend two short lines below the head to form the neck.
steps.body: Then, draw short lines at the bottom of each, diverging to begin the shoulders. From the ends of these, draw two curved lines that meet at a point below the neck. This outlines the neck of the garment. Next, enclose a large oval around the top of the head. Connect the open ends of the hair with a curved line. This forms the brim of the hat. Enclose the hat's crow with a curved line, and draw another curved line across it to indicate the hatband.

steps.title: Draw curved lines at each side of the neck, then draw overlapping curved lines diverging from them.
steps.body: This completes the neck and shoulders of the garment. Use a series of overlapping curved lines to sketch the arm of the garment and the top of the muscular arm.

steps.title: Use pairs of curved lines to sketch the upper and lower arm.
steps.body: Continue one line to outline the back of the hand. Use short curved lines to sketch the fingers and knuckles.

steps.title: Use a series of overlapping curved lines to sketch the remaining shoulder and arm of the garment.
steps.body: Draw the remaining fingers using overlapping curved lines.

steps.title: Use curved lines to sketch the remaining arm and hand.
Detail Luffy's torso.
steps.body: Use a small "C" shaped line and three straight lines to contour the collarbone and pectoral muscles. Draw the sides of the garment, its opening, and a large button.

steps.title: Color your picture

lessons.title: Deku
lessons.description: My Hero Academia'dan Izuku Midoriya.

steps.title: Begin by using a long curved line to outline Deku's face.
steps.body: Note the bulges of the cheeks and chin. Then, draw two curved lines across the face - one vertical and one horizontal. The lines should cross at a perpendicular angle. These guide lines will help you place the features of the face.

steps.title: Enclose an ear on each side of the face using a curved line.
steps.body: Detail the insides of the ears with additional curved lines. Then, use the horizontal guide line to help you place the eyes. It should run through the center of the eyes. Outline the eyes with large "C" shaped lines. Draw a small oval to form each pupil. Around it, draw the "C" shaped iris using a long curved line and short straight lines. Draw thick curved lines for the eyebrows, and short lines to contour the furrowed brow. Using the vertical line as a guide, use curved lines to draw the nose, mouth, and dimple of the chin. Shade dots on each cheek to indicate freckles.

steps.title: Erase the guide lines from the face, and begin drawing the spiky manga hair.
steps.body: For each strand of hair, use a pair of curved lines that meet at a jagged point. Draw hair across the forehead and below the ears.

steps.title: Use pairs of curved lines to enclose the hair on top of the head.
steps.body: The irregular locks should stick out in all directions like the rays or corona of the sun.

steps.title: Erase unnecessary lines from the hair.
steps.body: Then, Enclose the irregularly shaped collar of the garment using straight lines. Connect the collar to the head with a pair of lines, outlining the neck. Extend lines down from the collar, and connect them with straight lines. Embellish the collar with vertical lines and "C" shaped lines.

steps.title: Use straight lines to enclose irregular "L" shapes on the collar.
Use curved lines to enclose an irregular shape on each side of the collar; then, detail each shape with a curved line down the middle.
steps.body: Use long curved lines to outline the shoulders.

steps.title: Detail the neck with hatching, and use curved lines to draw a semicircular shape behind the collar.
steps.body: Detail the folds and edges of the garment with curved lines.

steps.title: Use pairs of curved lines to outline the squared "C" shapes of the shoulder pads.
steps.body: Draw a small oval in each corner and a curved line down each arm.

steps.title: Color your picture

lessons.title: Todoroki
lessons.description: Buz ve ateş güçleriyle Shoto Todoroki.

steps.title: Use a long curved line to outline the rounded shape of Todoroki's face.
steps.body: Draw a "t" shape across the face, using curved vertical and horizontal lines that cross at a perpendicular angle. These lines will serve as guides for placing the eyes, nose, and mouth.

steps.title: Draw the eyes, centered on the horizontal line.
steps.body: Use curved lines to outline the squinting shape of the eyes. Enclose a half-circle within each eye for the iris, and shade the small round pupil inside it. Use a thick curved line to draw an eyebrow above each anime eye. Then, using the vertical line as a guide, draw the nose, nostrils, and frowning mouth using curved lines.

steps.title: Erase the guide lines from the face and begin drawing Todoroki's spiky manga hair.
steps.body: Use pairs of curved lines that meet at jagged points to sketch his bangs as they fall between his eyes.

steps.title: Continue drawing hair on the sides of the face.
steps.body: Again, use pairs of curved lines that meet at jagged points. Outline the ears using curved lines.

steps.title: Use long, overlapping curved lines to draw the hair on top of the head.
steps.body: Note how the lines converge at the crown. Then, continue drawing jagged locks of hair.

steps.title: Erase guide lines from the hair.
steps.body: Draw curved lines down the center of the scalp, allowing some to meet at jagged points. This distinguishes his two-toned hair.

steps.title: Use curved lines to outline the collar and opening of the garment.
steps.body: Detail the neck with short curved lines.

steps.title: Use overlapping curved lines to draw the outer edges of the collar, folds in the fabric, and the shoulders.
Detail the garment with curved lines.
Color your picture

lessons.title: Itachi Uchiha
lessons.description: Naruto'daki Uchiha klanının dâhisi.

steps.title: Begin by drawing Itachi's unique anime eyes.
steps.body: Use thick curved lines to sketch the parallelogram shapes of the eyes. Within each eye, draw three successively smaller circles, shading the smallest to indicate the pupil. Then, draw a curved line parallel to the top of the eye to indicate the eyelid.

steps.title: Detail the irises of the eyes by shading three to four small ovals crossing the middle circle.
steps.body: Then, Use curved lines that meet at points on one end to contour the furrowed brow. Use curved lines to draw the bridge and tip of the nose, the nostril, and the creases on each side of the nose.

steps.title: Use curved lines to draw the mouth and the dimple of the chin.
steps.body: Then, draw Itachi's spiky manga hair. use long curved lines that meet at points. Between the strands of hair, draw four parallel lines, narrowly spaced in sets of two, to form the headband. Erase as necessary.

steps.title: Continue drawing the hair, using a series of long and short curved lines that meet at jagged points.
steps.body: Draw a curved line between the strands of hair to enclose the face and form the chin.

steps.title: Draw a long curved line to form the top of the head and hair.
steps.body: Use curved lines to draw the ear. Then, draw long curved lines extending from each side of the head. This forms the tall collar of Itachi's garment.

steps.title: Draw an "L" shaped line on one side of the collar and a curved line on the other, forming the front edge of the collar.
steps.body: Use curved lines to outline Itachi's neck, and draw a curved line parallel to the near edge of the collar.

steps.title: Draw curved lines between the sections of the collar, outlining the neck of Itachi's shirt.
steps.body: Detail the tendons of the neck with additional curved lines, and draw the shoulders and upper arm.

steps.title: Draw a necklace using a series of curved lines and small circles.
steps.body: Detail the shirt with overlapping straight lines in a checkerboard pattern.

steps.title: Use a curved line, a spiral, and a small triangle to draw the Leaf Village symbol on the headband.
steps.body: Enclose two small partial circles at the corners of the metal plate to indicate the rivets that secure it to the headband.

steps.title: Color your cartoon of Itachi.
steps.body: He has black hair and wears a black cloak trimmed in red. His eyes are red when he uses his Sharingan.

lessons.title: Naruto Uzumaki
lessons.description: Konoha'nın en tahmin edilemez ninjası.

steps.title: Begin by drawing a large circle.
steps.body: This will form Naruto's face.

steps.title: Beneath the circle, continue outlining the face by enclosing a shape using a curved line.
Erase the guide line formed by the original circle.
Draw a curved line across the top of the face.
steps.body: Draw two short lines connecting the long line to the sides of the face.

steps.title: Erase the guide lines formed by the original circle.
Enclose Naruto's headband above the face using a long, curved line.
steps.body: Allow the line to take on a wavy appearance at the sides to indicate ripples in the cloth.

steps.title: Draw Naruto's ears by enclosing elongated, roughly oval shapes on each side of the head.
Detail the ears using a series of connected, curved lines.
steps.body: Draw eyebrows extending from below the headband. Each eyebrow consists of two curved lines meeting at a point.

steps.title: Draw Naruto's eye.
steps.body: Begin by drawing two curved lines beneath the eyebrow. On one side, allow the lines to meet in a point; on the other, connect them with a short, straight line. Shade the enclosed shape. Draw a circle beneath this, with two smaller circles within. Shade the small circle in the center. Finally, draw a curved line beneath the e9. ye.

steps.title: Repeat this process on the opposite side to form a mirror image.
Draw three curved lines crossing each cheek.
steps.body: Indicate the nose by drawing two dots in the center of the face. Draw a straight line, upturned at each end, to indicate the mouth11.

steps.title: Draw a rounded rectangle within the headband.
Draw the Leaf Village symbol within the rectangle.
steps.body: This symbol consists of a spiral with a straight line extending from the end and a triangle extending from the opposite side. Draw three small circles on each end of the rectangle.

steps.title: Draw the neck by extending two straight lines downward from the face.
steps.body: Detail the neck using two short, diagonal lines.

steps.title: Draw Naruto's hair.
steps.body: Below each ear, extend a series of short, curved lines meeting in jagged points.

steps.title: Draw Naruto's clothing.
steps.body: To do this, draw two tall, rounded rectangles below the neck. Connect the rectangles at the top using a short, curved line, and extend a series of connected, curved lines outwards from each rectangle.

steps.title: Enclose the collar of the garment using a long, wavy line.
steps.body: Draw a zigzag line between the two rectangles. Texture the fabric by drawing long and short curved lines.

steps.title: Extend curved lines from the collar to the edge of the page.
steps.body: Draw roughly vertical curved lines to detail the garment.

steps.title: Give Naruto a full head of hair by drawing a series of spiky, connected straight lines above his head.
steps.body: Your drawing of Naruto's face is now ready.

steps.title: Color Naruto.
steps.body: He is typically depicted with yellow hair, blue eyes, and blue and orange clothing.

lessons.title: Zoro
lessons.description: One Piece'in üç kılıçlı dövüşçüsü.

steps.title: Begin the Zoro from One Piece outline by drawing the character’s face.
steps.body: Start with two roughly “S” shaped lines for the furrowed brows. Then, use two curved lines to enclose the eye beneath one. Shade a small oval-shaped pupil inside it.

steps.title: Use a series of curved lines to outline the nose, its tip, its nostrils, and the lids of both eyes.
steps.body: Then, shade a thick curved line below the remaining lid.

steps.title: Outline the face using a long curved line.
steps.body: Double the lines over at the top, doubling back on themselves to enclose the ears. Then, use two curved lines that meet at sharp points to enclose the open mouth. Contour the chin beneath it with a shorter curved line.

steps.title: Extend curved lines from each of the ears, outlining a curved rectangle shape around the face.
steps.body: Connect the lines at the top of the forehead by drawing a series of pointed locks of hair. Use pairs of curved lines that meet at sharp points.

steps.title: Enclose a shock of hair around the top of the head.
steps.body: Use a series of curved lines that meet at sharp points.

steps.title: Contour inside the ears with curved lines.
steps.body: Draw three earrings on one ear, erasing as necessary. Enclose three oblong rounded shapes and a small circle below each.

steps.title: Extend a curved line from the bottom of each earring and double it back on itself to enclose more oblong shapes.
steps.body: Then, draw Zoro’s neck. Extend a curved line from each cheek. Then, draw his garment by extending two long curved lines on each side of the neck.

steps.title: Draw a long curved line across the closed eye, forming the scar.
steps.body: Contour the neck and chest muscles with curved lines. Draw another curved line across the chest, and cross it with short lines, forming another scar. Then, extend a long curved line from each side of the garment, outlining the shoulders.

steps.title: Detail Zoro’s hair with short lines and “V” shaped lines.
steps.body: Contour the sides of the forehead and top of the nose with curved lines. Draw several short, horizontal lines below each sideburn of hair beside his ears.

steps.title: Bir daire çizerek başlayın.

steps.title: Küçük bir kısmı birincinin gölgesinde kalacak şekilde ikinci bir daire çizin.
steps.body: Bu ikinci kuşun kafasını oluşturacak.

steps.title: İkinci kuşun gövdesini çizmek için bu işlemi tekrarlayın.
steps.body: İlk önce neredeyse kesişen iki eğri çizgi çizin. Daha sonra kalp şeklindeki kuyruğu kapatın.

steps.title: Orijinal dairelerin bıraktığı kılavuz çizgilerini silin.
Her biri için birbirine bağlı iki "U" şeklinde çizgi kullanarak gövdelerin ortasına kanatları çizin.

steps.title: Her kuşun altına ayak çizin.
steps.body: Her bacak için vücuttan aşağı doğru kısa, düz bir çizgi uzatın. Daha sonra ayağı oluşturmak için bir üçgen içine alın. Üçgeni gölgeleyin.

steps.title: Kuşlarınıza üzerinde durabilecekleri bir yer verin.
steps.body: Kuşların altına iki uzun, paralel kavisli çizgiyi yatay olarak uzatarak bir ağaç dalı çizin. Dalın kabuğunu girdaplar ve kavisli çizgilerle dokulayın.

steps.title: Muhabbet kuşlarınızı renklendirin.
